steps.title: Free quote
steps.body: Tell us about your yard. We give you a firm price with no surprises.

steps.title: Schedule your first visit
steps.body: Pick a day that works. We show up on time with the right equipment.

steps.title: Consistent service every week
steps.body: Same crew, same standard, every single visit.

steps.title: Free yard assessment
steps.body: We walk your property and listen to what you want to achieve.

steps.title: Design proposal with visuals
steps.body: You see the plan and approve it before any work begins.

steps.title: Build on your timeline
steps.body: We install on the schedule we agreed to and clean up when we are done.
